description: List all projects available in the Jira instance.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of project objects (id, key, name, projectTypeKey, lead, description); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single issue by its issue key.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized issue (id, key, fields); on failure (issue does not exist), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new issue in a project.

project_key.description: The key of the project the issue belongs to (e.g. 'ENG').

description.description: Optional free-text description for the issue.

assignee.description: Optional account id of the user to assign the issue to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the new issue id, key, and self link; on failure (project not found or invalid assignee), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing issue by its key.

issue_key.description: The key of the issue to update (e.g. 'ENG-101').

summary.description: Optional new summary for the issue.

description.description: Optional new description for the issue.

assignee.description: Optional new assignee account id; an empty string clears the assignee.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the update (key, updated); on failure (issue does not exist), output contains an error message.

description: List the workflow transitions available for an issue from its current status.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a list of available transitions (id, name, to); on failure (issue does not exist), output contains an error message.

description: Apply a workflow transition to an issue, changing its status.

issue_key.description: The key of the issue to transition (e.g. 'ENG-101').

transition_id.description: The id of the transition to apply (as returned by get_transitions).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the new status (key, status, transitioned); on failure (issue does not exist or transition not valid), output contains an error message.

description: Search for issues using a small JQL subset supporting 'project = X' and 'status = Y' joined by AND.

jql.description: Optional JQL query string; supports 'project = X' and 'status = Y' clauses joined by AND.

max_results.description: Maximum number of issues to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a search result object (expand, startAt, maxResults, total, issues); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List all agile boards in the Jira instance.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated object with a list of board values (id, name, type, location); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the sprints belonging to a board, optionally filtered by state.

board_id.description: The numeric id of the board.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated object with a list of sprint values; on failure (board not found), output contains an error message.
